theme_strategy: Light mode prioritized (High-Density Dashboard for data entry). Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for clinical/financial trust.

headings.instruction: Use tracking-tight for H1/H2. Avoid standard Inter for headings. Use for Dashboard titles, stat card values.

body.instruction: Crucial for tabular data. Use class `tabular-nums` for all numeric columns (Rupiah, Qty, Totals) to ensure decimal alignment.

brand.instruction: Deep Forest Green to symbolize veterinary/pharmacy trust and financial stability. Use for primary buttons, active states, and Sidebar highlights.

spacing_and_layout.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar (w-64), collapsed on mobile. Dense navigation links (py-2).
spacing_and_layout.main_content: Edge-to-edge padding (px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8) to maximize table width.
spacing_and_layout.tables: Use 'border-collapse'. Keep padding tight (px-3 py-2 or py-3). Add sticky headers.

component_instructions.cards: Flat design. 1px border (#E2E8F0), no shadow by default, subtle shadow-sm on hover. Rounded-md.
component_instructions.inputs: Dense form fields. Use h-8 or h-9 for inputs inside the Sales Entry table to maximize visible rows.
component_instructions.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md), crisp edges. Avoid large pill shapes for dense data environments.
component_instructions.tables: CRITICAL: Must include zebra striping (odd:bg-white even:bg-slate-50). Right-align all currency and quantity columns. Use Shadcn Table primitives.
component_instructions.slide_overs: Use Shadcn Sheet for 'Add Product' or 'Edit Product' to prevent losing context of the inventory table.

visual_enhancers.status_badges: Use soft backgrounds with crisp text (e.g., bg-red-100 text-red-800 for 'Expired' or 'Low Stock').
visual_enhancers.dividers: Use border-slate-200 to separate header from content and sidebar from main content.

pages.login: Split screen. Left: crisp white login form. Right: full bleed image from image_urls.
pages.dashboard: Top row: 3-4 StatCards (Total Modal, Total Products, Today's Sales). Clean minimal design.
pages.inventory: Full width table. Columns: Nama Produk, QTY, Harga Modal, Modal/QTY, Stock, Modal/Fisik, Total Modal, Keterangan.
pages.sales: Two-part layout: Top section for Date/Meta, Bottom section is a dynamic editable table for line items (Product, Qty, Price, Total) with a persistent Grand Total bar at the bottom.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`, `data-testid="inventory-table-row"`).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over brand colors meets APCA standards. Focus rings must be visible (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-600 focus:ring-offset-2).

login_background.description: Brown glass bottles on a laboratory shelf, ideal for pharmacy/vet context. Use on the right half of the login page.

login_background_alt.description: Clean sterile hospital/clinic hallway. Fallback option for login screen.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Left-align data tables, right-align numbers.
Use glass-morphism ONLY for sticky headers or dropdowns if necessary, but prefer solid `#FFFFFF` with borders for data-heavy apps to prevent refraction.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded with interaction animations).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (robot, brain, lightbulb) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing for high-level layouts, but tight padding (`p-2`, `p-3`) inside dense data tables.
Number formatting is CRITICAL: Ensure Rupiah (Rp) is formatted correctly with thousand separators (e.g., Rp 1.500.000).
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background
